recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If OO still wants the FHIR-25799 voted guidance preserved, follow up in the OO Incubator IG source for DeviceUsage; no current core source edit is appropriate unless DeviceUsage returns to the core build.
issue_request: FHIR-25799 was a Published/Persuasive OO R5 issue asking to improve DeviceUseStatement.device after DeviceDefinition was introduced. The approved resolution said to update usageStatus with at least InUse and DoNotUse and add non-invariant text saying actual use should reference Device while non-use should reference DeviceDefinition when more than a code is needed.
initial_application: DeviceUseStatement/DeviceUsage was partly applied historically: commit 33b409a4b6 introduced the rebuilt StructureDefinition with DeviceUseStatement.device as CodeableReference(Device | DeviceDefinition), and commit 0763661ef79399537866358e94efadccc2577c4a added a usageStatus binding in a commit whose subject included 25799. The retained DeviceUsage.device text still lacks the voted use-vs-non-use guidance.
additional_context: DeviceUseStatement was renamed to DeviceUsage for R5. Current source/fhir.ini no longer includes DeviceUsage in the active resources list and only retains DeviceUseStatement=@DeviceUsage as a rename map. Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed DeviceUsage from core build metadata and redirected active core narrative links to the OO Incubator IG. The current core DeviceUsage page returns 404, while the OO Incubator DeviceUsage artifact is reachable.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. Editing source/deviceusage would only modify retained out-of-build core files, not the current built FHIR core specification, so the seed was reconciled with an empty external-repo audit commit.
